title: Chocolate Cookies
description: Deliciously rich and chewy chocolate cookies, loaded with chocolate chips.
author: Chris Garza
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, cream together softened butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until light and fluffy.
Beat in the egg and vanilla extract.
In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, cocoa powder, baking soda, and salt.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined.
Fold in chocolate chips if using.
Drop spoonfuls of dough onto the prepared baking sheet (about 1.5-inch balls).
Bake for 8–10 minutes, until the edges are set. The cookies will continue to cook on the sheet.
Let the cookies cool for a few minutes on the baking sheet, then transfer to a wire rack.

title: Cilantro Crema
author: Jackie's Mimaw
instructions: Sear peppers on a cast iron skillet or in a toaster oven. Cut and remove seeds.
Add all ingredients to a blender or food processor and blend until creamy and smooth.
tips: If you want a spicy version, add a serrano.

title: Migas and Bacon
description: A simple Tex-Mex breakfast dish featuring fried tortilla strips scrambled with eggs, served alongside crispy bacon.
author: Jackie's Mimaw
instructions: Cut bacon slices in half, cut tortillas into squares, and whisk eggs with pepper in a separate bowl.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add bacon and cook until dark or lightly blackened, keeping the skillet covered.
Remove bacon to a paper towel-lined plate.
Add tortilla squares to the skillet and stir, increasing heat slightly.
Once sizzling, reduce heat, remove tortillas to a plate, and lightly salt.
Add butter to the pan and let it melt.
Add the egg mixture and cook on medium-low heat, covered.
When the eggs are mostly cooked, stir in the tortilla squares and serve with bacon.
